consistency: Read committed completed fixture from a new connection; concurrent mutation/isolation claims are pending.
atomicity: One native INSERT statement; ambiguous acknowledgement/transaction boundaries not yet fault-tested.
idempotency: Unique Key order_id with sequence column; concurrent retry and conflicting revisions pending.
delete_ttl: DROP for teardown; row delete/TTL pending.
durability: RF1, one FE and BE with retained Docker volumes. No independent backup or permanent disk-loss tolerance.
retry: No mutation retry. Readiness retries only the known transient unavailable-FE startup error within a 90-second budget.
client: Go MySQL driver v1.9.3, one connection, 5-second connect and 120-second read/write timeout; verification context 5 minutes.
